THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.438 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO  ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF HIS  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:21475  CRL.P No. 3702 of 2023 ARREST IN CR.NO.122/2022 OF DODDABELAVANGALA POLICE,
FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 468,34,420 AND 471 OF THE IPC AND TO RELEASE THE PETITIONER BY THE RESPONDENT POLICE.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that accused No.1 has been enlarged on bail by the learned Magistrate and therefore even the petitioner may be permitted to appear before the learned Magistrate and file an application under Section 437 of Cr.P.C. and seek regular bail.
Hence, he submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the present petition with the said liberty.

2. In the light of the above submission, this petition seeking anticipatory bail is dismissed as withdrawn reserving liberty to the petitioner to appear before the jurisdictional Court and file necessary application seeking bail and in that event, the said application shall be disposed of by the learned Magistrate expeditiously, in accordance with law.

Sd/-
JUDGE VBS CT: STK Sri. Mahaveer Jain.
